documentary_ceiling.reason: The complete universe of institutional backups is not enumerable; the REV3-REV6 CEDIA search is bounded to sources stated in its read-only receipt.
documentary_ceiling.qualitative: Use per-item recovery categories below. Do not describe a bounded negative search as global nonexistence.

latest_bounded_search.interpretation: The search extends the documented filename-search boundary in the named CEDIA roots; it found no matching names and does not establish global absence or add scientific coverage.
